name: Tanaris
summary: In Tanaris, goblins trade beneath a fierce sun as dangers stir in the sands. Gadgetzan welcomes both the Alliance and the Horde, while Sandfury trolls, silithid, and ancient powers hold the dunes beyond.

sections.title: A Sea of Dunes
sections.body: Tanaris lies beneath a fierce sun, and sand covers much of the land. Within Zul'Farrak's walls, the Sandfury trolls guard their isolated home. Hyenas, basilisks, and scorpids roam the desert floor. Tunnels wind beneath the hot earth.

sections.title: Goblin Enterprise
sections.body: Close to the goblins' island homeland of Kezan, Tanaris has become a trading ground for the Steamwheedle Cartel. From walled Gadgetzan to the docks of steamwheedle port, the goblins welcome coin from the Alliance and the Horde alike. Bruisers keep the peace, yet Southsea Freebooters still harass ships and dig sites along the coast.

sections.title: Ancient Mysteries and Rising Perils
sections.body:
Tanaris holds powers older than mortal empires. In the east, the Caverns of Time belong to Nozdormu and the bronze dragonflight. Their drakes sometimes ride the desert thermals.

Farther south, massive stone gates mark the titan complex of Uldum. Silithid swarms burrow outward from nests such as the Gaping Chasm and the Noxious Lair.

faq.q: How do I travel to Tanaris?
faq.answer: Travel through Thousand Needles on foot to reach the Shimmering Flats. At the salt flats' southern end, a mountain pass leads down into Tanaris, with Gadgetzan's walls immediately in sight. Ships also sail from Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades to Steamwheedle Port on the eastern coast.

faq.q: Why is Gadgetzan neutral to both factions?
aliases: can horde and alliance go to gadgetzan
faq.answer: The Steamwheedle Cartel governs Gadgetzan and gives its allegiance to profit. To protect trade and draw commerce, the goblins enforce neutrality. Their bruisers attack anyone who starts a faction fight inside the city walls.
Zul'Farrak is the walled desert capital of the Sandfury trolls. Isolated in the desert, the tribe grew hostile to outsiders and guards its sacred pools and mysterious shrines.

faq.q: What are the insect creatures nesting across the desert?
aliases: what are the bugs in tanaris
faq.answer: The insectlike beasts are silithid, monstrous burrowers that build vast hives such as the Gaping Chasm and the Noxious Lair. Their emergence in Tanaris unsettles Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser, recalling the ancient horrors of the War of the Shifting Sands.

faq.q: What is behind the massive stone doors in the south?
faq.answer: The massive gates in the Valley of the Watchers mark the entrance to Uldum, a research facility held by the ancient titans. Colossal stone sentinels guard its sealed entrance, while scholars and goblins watch from afar.

faq.q: Who dwells inside the Caverns of Time?
aliases: what is in caverns of time
faq.answer: The Caverns of Time are the ancestral home of the bronze dragonflight and their aspect, Nozdormu. From hidden, winding depths, the timeless dragons watch the flow of history. They sometimes patrol the skies above the southern dunes.

angles.text: Tanaris's arid cliffs and rocky outcrops hold veins of Mithril, Truesilver, Iron, and Gold. Scattered deposits of Small Thorium lie deeper in the desert.
The dry heat of Tanaris nurtures Firebloom across the shifting dunes. Shaded ruins and damp oases shelter valuable Purple Lotus.
As a troll, Zul'Farrak's Sandfury trolls show you ancient cousins who forged a brutal culture in the desert's isolation.
As an Alliance traveler, you find no major Alliance strongholds between Dustwallow Marsh and Feralas. Neutral Gadgetzan gives you a vital staging post for travel across southern Kalimdor.
As a member of the Horde, you can use Gadgetzan as a trade hub linking routes from Freewind Post and Camp Mojache to the silithid-infested wastes of the far south.
